actual_call.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. One square premium MACRO real product photograph, no text. Image1 actual silver face/button closeup, image2 actual whole front, image3 actual side. Image4 is STYLE ONLY A025: borrow its large detailed panel crop and calm pale blue-white upper-left title space, NOT its different white product, hand rubbing, typography, icons or performance claims. ACTUAL PRODUCT DETAILS: realistic bright mirror SILVER shell/rim, black finely textured face, dense small off-white separate nozzle rings each with a dark center, original dark microhole outer border. Central RED control is the actual low wide circular flange plus smaller concentric raised boss with dark center opening; do not enlarge relative to neighboring holes, do not replace with a huge doughnut or add a new black pedestal. The separate lower button is the actual shiny SILVER rounded-rectangle in black insert, not black and not a red control. Exact source-photo visual character, not CG clay. No text, letters, logos, arrows, diagrams, performance comparisons, dimensions, filter parts, certificates, human/hand/finger, water or spray. Dry resting product; no press-action, no long red needles, no exploding internals. Real product photographs override all other references. COMPOSITION: ONE large macro photograph only, not a full product and not a two-card design. Upper-left/top28% clear pale icy blue-white negative space. From middle to bottom-right, the real BLACK circular face fills frame; crop its lower/right edges naturally to show a generous local field of crisp individual WHITE nozzle rings and the original RED central control. Red control positioned around x65%,y64%, approximately16% of frame width at the SAME relative scale to real rings as the original actual photo. Show about8–12 visible nozzle spacings across the crop; individual rings should appear tactile and separate, with dark recessed center holes, no smears or duplicate-ring ghosts. The real silver rim can curve through far lower/right edge but do not add long handle or lower selector: this image is exclusively the central face/button/nozzle detail. Camera near-front with slight photo perspective. Natural fine black surface texture, realistic red plastic gloss and softly reflective silver edge. Clean dry unpressed state; no red needles protruding, no hand, no water. Do not represent a before/after cleaning demonstration.
